summary: DesignGradeMapRepository.list_active_all appended cleanly. Existing 6 repository classes and the 2 existing DesignGradeMap methods are byte-identical to S1. The new method uses the correct JOIN-on-grade pattern with BOTH map.is_active AND grade.is_active predicates and no design_id filter, satisfying TC-150/151/152 and the AC-012/AC-017 cascade requirements.

spec.notes: Method signature `list_active_all(self) -> list[DesignGradeMapModel]` matches LLD files[7].functions[0] exactly. Implementation logic is verbatim from T-060-plan.md lines 22-33. No design_id parameter (correct per LLD).

contract.notes: Exports DesignGradeMapRepository (existing class extended with one new method) per LLD interfaces.exports. Imports `select`, `DesignGradeMapModel`, `GradeModel` already present at top of file (lines 1-10) — no new imports required, as anticipated in plan. `self.session` inherited from BaseRepository (verified). The `.design` and `.grade` relationships on DesignGradeMapModel are `lazy='joined'` (master model lines 101-102), so the scalar load eager-fetches both — T-061's DashboardService projection of design_name/size/grade_code will not trigger N+1.

test.notes: TC-150 satisfied: 4 active pairs across 3 designs → returns 4 rows (no design_id filter). TC-151 satisfied: `DesignGradeMapModel.is_active.is_(True)` predicate excludes the map_id=2 deactivated row. TC-152 satisfied: INNER JOIN to GradeModel with `GradeModel.is_active.is_(True)` predicate excludes the row whose parent grade was soft-deleted. AC-012 + AC-017 cascade both honored by the dual is_active predicate exactly as DS-008 (soft-delete) requires.

security.notes: No user input flows into the query. Pure SQLAlchemy core expression — parameter binding handled by the driver. No string interpolation, no f-strings in SQL, no exposed secrets.

structural.notes: graph.json exists.
